dict.string: XM6 Hub needs Bluetooth access to connect to your Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones and show battery status and controls.
XM6 Hub checks your calendar to warn when battery may run out during an upcoming meeting, and to apply meeting ANC profiles.
XM6 Hub uses your location to apply location-based ANC profiles and read your Wi‑Fi network name.
XM6 Hub uses your location for location-based ANC profiles and Wi‑Fi network detection.
